source: HighLevel conversations API, read-only, at service businesses Megawebvision runs in the United States and Canada. Shares only; no lead, contact, message or business is identifiable.

definitions.lead: conversation whose first message is inbound, or a contact created by a form or web lead whose first message is an automated reply within 10 minutes of creation; outbound-first threads are outreach and excluded
definitions.after_hours: lead arrived outside 08:00 to 18:00 Monday to Friday in the account's own timezone
definitions.missed: inbound call with status no-answer, busy or voicemail
definitions.callback: first outbound call or human-sent CRM message after a missed call
definitions.automated_reply: first outbound message sent by automation (chat bot, auto-reply or workflow) after the lead arrived
